ac1_repeated_next_page_token_fails_throu.detail: Updated collectPaginatedListPages in src/lib/bff-v1/domainReads.ts so seenTokens.has(nextToken) fails through the exact same liveStatus.reportFallback('strict: ...') and throw makeBffError({ code: 'BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE', message }) error path as reaching maxPages, returning no partial rows. Two-page cycle tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/domainReads.allPages.test.ts and src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/lists.test.ts prove that when page 1 and page 2 both return next_page_token='200', the read rejects with BffError (code='BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE'), reports strict fallback, and returns no partial rows.

ac2_risk_center_open_incident_count_with.detail: Updated listIncidents in src/lib/bff-v1/operations.ts to reuse strictLivePaginatedList<Incident> when a status filter is supplied (as used by RiskCenter.tsx via NON_TERMINAL_INCIDENT_STATUS_FILTER and listOpenIncidents), keeping status=open,investigating,mitigating,in_progress on every paginated GET (/bff/incidents?status=...&page_size=200 and /bff/incidents?status=...&page_size=200&page_token=20). Unfiltered bffV1.incidents.list() and lists.incidents (used by the general incidents page) remain untouched. Tests in domainReads.allPages.test.ts and RiskCenter.test.tsx prove that 21 open incidents across two pages produce an Open Incidents KPI count of 21 and render the 21st open incident.

ac3_strategy_reads_return_bff_dto_withou.detail: Removed normalizeStrategyRecord and normalizeStrategyList from src/lib/bff-v1/strategies.ts so listNonDraftStrategies, listStrategiesForPersona, and getStrategy return the BFF DTO emitted by services/control-plane/bff/strategies/routes/common.py directly without fabricating persona_ids, persona_id, personaId, or capital_pool_id aliases and without coercing null fields to empty strings. Tests in domainReads.allPages.test.ts, PersonaDetail.test.ts, CapitalPoolDetail.test.tsx, and PersonaCapitalBindingTab.test.tsx verify real rows with personaIds, capitalPoolId, and alpha still reach every caller.

ac4_owner_read_counts_and_no_second_page.detail: All paginated reads continue to flow through the single shared collectPaginatedListPages helper in src/lib/bff-v1/domainReads.ts; no second pagination mechanism was added and owner read counts remain unchanged.

ac5_no_weakened_or_deleted_tests_and_cha.detail: No existing test was weakened or deleted. All changed assertions are justified below.
